'''September 2001 Chatswood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Chatswood, Sydney, Australia on 23 September 2001. [[Matthew Mohl]] won it. It is known from Matthew Mohl's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2995">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ sydney-australia-23-09-2001], DeckTech (Matthew "Capsolo" Mohl, 25 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Chatswood, Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Mohl]]
